tools.description: Technical signals for up to 10 US, Hong Kong or China A-share stocks: latest close, 1-day and 5-day change, and 8 indicator dimensions (MACD, MA, RSI, KDJ, Bollinger, ADX, volume, money flow), each bullish / bearish / neutral with a 5-day trail and the latest values (e.g. RSI, KDJ K/D/J, MACD DIF/DE

tools.name: get_my_portfolio
tools.description: Your saved PickSkill portfolios (pickskill.ai/portfolios): holdings and weights, plus each holding's latest price change and its 8 indicator signals, with bullish/bearish counts per holding for a quick health check. Costs 1 PickSkill API credit; failed calls are refunded.

tools.name: get_earnings_highlights
tools.description: A company's latest earnings release (report date, actual vs. estimated EPS, surprise) plus its key financial ratios (valuation, margins, ROE, leverage, growth). Best for US-listed stocks. Costs 2 PickSkill API credits; failed calls are refunded.
